name: cantcoap
description: cantcoap (staropram/cantcoap): a minimal BSD-2 CoAP PDU construction/parsing library in C++. It is ONLY a message codec — no sockets, no retransmission, no DTLS, no block-wise state machine. Built from source via an overlay port with a vendored CMakeLists (upstream ships no build system). SKELETON: a from-scratch alternate CoAP backend for kythira's coap_transport (include/raft/coap_transport_cantcoap_impl.hpp), gated behind the opt-in "coap-cantcoap" feature.
